summary: Tested India Online-branch routing. No real WhatsApp was sent. Backend: new file test_iter18_online_branch.py has 16 tests and all pass. (1) Preview of the Centralized tab returns columns_with_online = [how_would_you_prefer_to_attend_a_counselling_session?]. (2) _branch_route_key maps online + ludhiana/amritsar/jammu/pathankot_branch_ to online_<branch>, online with no branch to 'online', and offline rows to the branch. (3) A live first import of Centralized as the India admin (send_to_existing False, auto-sync off) imported 427 rows, all with whatsapp=skipped and queued 0. route_key counts: online_ludhiana 115, online_amritsar 32, online_jammu 20, online_pathankot 9, ludhiana 118, amritsar 70, jammu 50, pathankot 13. Every row matched _branch_route_key. The connection was deleted (427 leads deleted), so India now has 0 sheets and 0 campaign_leads. (4) A unit test of a second sync with new rows, using a temp DB and a monkeypatched send_routed_whatsapp, gave online_ludhiana, online_pathankot, amritsar and online (no online branch). (5) Legacy check: with no online_branch_column, online rows go to 'online'. Frontend: Centralized auto-maps Preferred Branch and shows online-branch-section, auto-filled with which_branch_would_you_prefer_for_your_online_counselling_session?. There are 3 role selects and role-online_branch_col is gone. Clearing the Online column and saving shows the toast 'Choose which column has the Online branch' and sends no POST. The intercepted payload has online_branch_column set, online_branch_col -1 and auto off. Remapping Preferred Branch to a column with no online values hides the section. Berlin modal: only berlin-name-column and berlin-phone-column, and no online section. FAILED: the Pathankot tabs DO contain the value 'online', so the section is shown, not hidden as the spec says. Save is then blocked.

minor.issue: If online_branch_column is saved but the tab does not have that column (a stale value sent from the UI for a Pathankot tab, see below), the code silently falls back to the generic 'online' route. It may be better business logic to route online rows of a single-branch tab (Pathankot form) to online_pathankot. Needs a product decision.

ui_bugs.issue: The Pathankot tabs (gid 545121451: 22 of 26 rows 'online'; gid 1798667875: 39 of 52 rows 'online') have online values in where_would_you_prefer_to_attend_the_counselling_session? but no online-branch column. So needsOnline is true and the section shows with an empty select listing 22 unrelated columns. Save & import is blocked with 'Choose which column has the Online branch', so the user cannot connect a Pathankot tab without picking a meaningless column. This contradicts the spec ('Pathankot tabs => section hidden'). Fix: only show or require the section when the tab has a candidate online-branch column (headers matching /online/ and /branch|centre/), or make it optional. For tabs without one, consider routing online rows to the generic 'online' template or the tab's own branch.

onlineCol is never reset when the picked tabs change. Steps: pick Centralized (auto-filled), then deselect it and pick Pathankot. The select shows the placeholder because the old value is not in onlineChoices, but validation passes and the POST payload has online_branch_column='which_branch_would_you_prefer_for_your_online_counselling_session?', a column that does not exist in that tab. What the select shows does not match what is saved. Fix: reset onlineCol when it is not in onlineChoices (add an effect on headerKey).

issues: Preferred Branch is not auto-mapped (campaign-mapping-5 is empty). The header 'where_you_want_to_attend_the_counselling_?__' is not in the preferredbranch aliases, so this tab (5 'online' rows) gets no branch routing unless the user maps it by hand.

action_items: Pathankot tabs: do not block Save when the tab has no online-branch column. Hide the section or make it optional when there are no candidate columns (and decide whether online rows there go to 'online' or online_pathankot).
Reset onlineCol when the picked tabs or headers change and the value is not in onlineChoices, so a stale online_branch_column is not saved.
Add 'whereyouwanttoattendthecounselling' to the preferredbranch aliases in guessColumn, for the Amritsar form.
critical_code_review_comments: needsOnline checks only whether the branch column has 'online' values. It should also check that an online-branch column exists in the picked tab(s).
When several tabs are picked, one onlineCol is used for all of them. Tabs without that column fall back to the backend heuristic or 'online' with no warning.
server.py is over 5200 lines and should be split into modules (campaign sheets, WA routing).

success_rate.frontend: 80% (Centralized flow, validation, hide-on-remap and Berlin regression pass; Pathankot hidden-section expectation fails)

seed_data_creation: A temporary India connection TEST_iter18_online (Centralized gid 99742259) was created, synced as a first import only (0 WhatsApp), then deleted along with its 427 leads. Temp DBs iter18_unit_tmp* were dropped. Berlin: 185 leads before and after, EU and NON-EU untouched.
